primitives.name: Sealed Path Enforcement
primitives.verbatim_quote: Hooks (rung 0 — the enforcement layer) cp -r .claude/hooks /path/to/Sports/.claude/ chmod +x /path/to/Sports/.claude/hooks/*.sh Merge `.claude/settings.json` into your existing one (do not overwrite — you may already have keys there).
